an3.109:1.1: 110 athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an3.109:1.2: citte gahapati arakkhite kāyakammampi arakkhitaṃ hoti vacīkammampi arakkhitaṃ hoti manokammampi arakkhitaṃ hoti
an3.109:1.3: tassa arakkhitakāyakammassa arakkhitavacīkammassa arakkhitamanokammassa kāyakammampi avassutaṃ hoti vacīkammampi avassutaṃ hoti manokammampi avassutaṃ hoti
an3.109:1.4: tassa avassutakāyakammassa avassutavacīkammassa avassutamanokammassa kāyakammampi pūtikaṃ hoti vacīkammampi pūtikaṃ hoti manokammampi pūtikaṃ hoti
an3.109:1.5: tassa pūtikāyakammassa pūtivacīkammassa pūtimanokammassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.109:2.1: seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre ducchanne kūṭampi arakkhitaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi arakkhitā honti bhittipi arakkhitā hoti
an3.109:2.2: kūṭampi avassutaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi avassutā honti bhittipi avassutā hoti
an3.109:2.3: kūṭampi pūtikaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi pūtikā honti bhittipi pūtikā hoti
an3.109:3.4: na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.109:4.1: citte gahapati rakkhite kāyakammampi rakkhitaṃ hoti vacīkammampi rakkhitaṃ hoti manokammampi rakkhitaṃ hoti
an3.109:4.2: tassa rakkhitakāyakammassa rakkhitavacīkammassa rakkhitamanokammassa kāyakammampi anavassutaṃ hoti vacīkammampi anavassutaṃ hoti manokammampi anavassutaṃ hoti
an3.109:4.3: tassa anavassutakāyakammassa anavassutavacīkammassa anavassutamanokammassa kāyakammampi apūtikaṃ hoti vacīkammampi apūtikaṃ hoti manokammampi apūtikaṃ hoti
an3.109:4.4: tassa apūtikāyakammassa apūtivacīkammassa apūtimanokammassa bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.109:5.1: seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre succhanne kūṭampi rakkhitaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi rakkhitā honti bhittipi rakkhitā hoti
an3.109:5.2: kūṭampi anavassutaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi anavassutā honti bhittipi anavassutā hoti
an3.109:5.3: kūṭampi apūtikaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi apūtikā honti bhittipi apūtikā hoti
